proof: Undoing only the new generator paragraph, in memory, exactly reproduces the 432-case library fingerprint. Actor/runtime and final extraction implementation are unchanged.

generator_cases.manual_review: Food-adventurous early adopter, traditional-food early adopter and novelty-resistant mild-food adult retain the corresponding individual preferences. No exhaustive audit of every sampled dimension is claimed.
generator_cases.scope: A paragraph-equivalent preintegration candidate, with different surrounding blank-line spacing. The later real-factory core cases exercise the exact production template.
generator_cases.request_format_caveat: The three raw generator replays omitted the production factory's response_format=json_object setting. They are exploratory content checks, not exact-production request replays. The two real-factory core cases independently exercise production JSON mode.

regression_development.cause: The two new assertions unintentionally prohibited descriptions of actual relatives. Separate diagnostics verified eligibility, food preference and catalog absence in both unchanged biographies; only that unintended restriction failed.
regression_development.correction: The assertion now explicitly permits actual relatives while retaining all intended eligibility, food-preference and no-population-catalog requirements.
regression_development.earlier_existing_guards: The existing parent-eligibility and infant-age cases passed on the new production prompt in the initial four-case run.

actor_replays.finding: Removing catalogs and separately regenerating scoped biographies did not change these purchase ratings. The fidelity repair is not a demonstrated calibration solution.
actor_replays.scope: Frozen first-turn replays, not full simulation rollouts; raw candidates were not quality-corrected. All public replies were read directly, without inferring from THINK/DONE.

correction_audit.finding: Only infants were regenerated in CF5. No adult purchase rating was selected by a correction loop; disabling it would not explain those observed adult ratings.
